title: Sign in and reach the protected dashboard
description: Verifies a user can sign in from the login page and is redirected to the dashboard where the main dashboard content is visible.

steps.description: Verify the user lands on the dashboard
Verify KPI cards and operational alerts are displayed

title: Dashboard access is gated for signed-out users
description: Verifies that navigating to the dashboard while signed out does not show protected dashboard content.

steps.description: Verify the user is redirected to the login page

title: Create a manual lead and see it in the leads list
description: Verifies that a user can create a manual lead with country and phone and the new lead appears in the leads list.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open leads
Start creating a new manual lead
Select a country for the lead
Fill a unique phone number into the phone field
Verify the new lead appears in the leads list

title: Send a manual message in a conversation
description: Verifies an agent can send a manually written message in a conversation and the sent message appears appended in the thread.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open mensajes
Select a conversation from the conversation list
Fill a unique message into the message composer
Verify the new outgoing message appears in the message thread

title: Register a venta call outcome and then close a lead as venta
description: Verifies an agent can record a venta call outcome and then close the related lead as venta with the closure allowed by rules.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open llamadas
Select a call from the call list
Select the post-call result outcome venta
Fill a short note into the call notes field
Click the navigation item to open leads
Select the lead linked to the updated call
Change the lead status to venta
Verify the lead is shown as closed as venta and a lead status history entry is visible

title: Filter/sort leads and change lead status with history update
description: Verifies that filtering/sorting leads, selecting a lead, and changing its status results in an updated status history in the lead workspace.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open leads
Start creating a new manual lead
Select a country for the lead
Fill a unique phone number into the phone field
Apply a leads filter that keeps the new lead visible
Select the newly created lead from the list
Change the lead status to a different valid state
Verify the lead status history shows a new entry for the status change

title: Message persistence after reload
description: Verifies that a sent message persists in the conversation thread after a page reload.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open mensajes
Select a conversation from the conversation list
Fill a unique message into the message composer
Select the same conversation from the conversation list
Verify the previously sent outgoing message is still present in the message thread

title: Prevent closing a lead as venta without a registered call
description: Verifies that attempting to mark a lead as venta without any registered call is blocked with a validation message and the lead is not closed.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open leads
Start creating a new manual lead
Select a country for the lead
Fill a unique phone number into the phone field
Select the newly created lead from the list
Attempt to change the lead status to venta
Verify a closure validation error is visible
Verify the lead is not marked as closed

title: Send an approved template message
description: Verifies an agent can apply an approved template to the composer, send it, and see the templated message appear in the thread.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open mensajes
Select a conversation from the conversation list
Verify the templated outgoing message appears in the message thread

title: Submit a post-call result and notes
description: Verifies an agent can submit a call outcome with notes and see the updated result badge and call history entry.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open llamadas
Select a call from the call list
Select a valid post-call result outcome
Fill a short note into the call notes field
Verify the call shows the updated result and an update entry is visible in call history

title: Country filter updates dashboard KPIs
description: Verifies that applying a country filter changes the dashboard KPI view to reflect the selected country.

steps.description: Select a specific country in the dashboard country filter
Verify the KPI cards update to reflect the selected country

title: View conversation thread from inbox
description: Verifies an agent can open a conversation from the inbox and see the full message thread and history displayed.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open mensajes
Select a conversation from the conversation list
Verify the message thread and message history are displayed for the selected conversation

title: Complete a task and see status history updated
description: Verifies an agent can mark a task as completada and the task history shows the status change.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open tareas
Select a task from the task list
Update the task status to completada
Verify the task shows as completada and a status change entry appears in task history

title: Open an alert and navigate to related leads
description: Verifies that selecting a dashboard alert shows its context and allows navigation to the related leads view.

steps.description: Click an alert to inspect its context
Click the action to review related leads
Verify the user lands on the leads page
Verify the leads list is displayed

title: Navigate from conversation to linked lead
description: Verifies an agent can use the conversation CTA to open the linked lead and land in the leads workspace for that lead.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open mensajes
Select a conversation from the conversation list
Click the CTA to open the linked lead
Verify the user lands on the leads page with a lead workspace/detail area visible

title: Filter tasks by status and schedule window
description: Verifies an agent can filter tasks by status and schedule window and see the task list update to match the selected filters.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open tareas
Verify the task list reflects the selected status and schedule window filters

title: Update a user's role and country assignment and see it reflected
description: Verifies an admin can change a user's role and country assignment and the user list shows the updated assignment.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open configuration
Select a user from the list to edit assignments
Select a new role for the user
Select a new country assignment for the user
Verify the selected user's row reflects the updated role and country assignment

title: Create a new campaign draft and see it in the list
description: Verifies a user can create a campaign draft and the new draft appears in the campaigns list.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open campaigns
Start creating a new campaign draft
Fill a unique campaign name into the campaign name field
Select a valid country or audience option
Verify the new campaign draft appears in the campaigns list

title: Trigger an automation run and review run summary and audit entry
description: Verifies an admin can trigger an automation run and see a run summary along with a new audit entry.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open configuration
Verify an automation run summary is displayed
Verify an audit log entry for the automation run is displayed

title: View call details and linked lead from call list
description: Verifies an agent can browse calls, select a call, and see its details including the linked lead reference.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open llamadas
Select a call from the call list
Verify call details are displayed and a linked lead reference is visible

title: Create and edit a country entry and see it in the list
description: Verifies an admin can create a country entry, edit it, and the updated country list reflects the change.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open configuration
Start creating a new country entry
Fill a unique country name into the country name field
Open the newly created country entry for editing
Fill an updated country name into the country name field
Verify the country list includes the updated country entry

title: Filter campaigns list by search and status
description: Verifies a user can search and filter campaigns and the list updates to show only matching results.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open campaigns
Fill a campaign name keyword into the search field
Select a campaign status filter option
Verify the campaigns list shows only results matching the search and selected status

title: Edit message template settings and see updated configuration summary
description: Verifies an admin can update message template settings and saved changes appear in the configuration summary.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open configuration
Select an existing message template to edit
Update one editable template field with a unique value
Verify the configuration summary reflects the updated template settings

title: Open a campaign to review details and recipient logs
description: Verifies a user can open a campaign from the list and view its details along with per-recipient log statuses.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open campaigns
Click a campaign in the list to open its details
Verify per-recipient campaign logs with statuses are displayed

title: Edit automation parameters and see updated configuration summary
description: Verifies an admin can update automation parameters and the configuration summary shows the saved changes.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open configuration
Update one automation parameter to a valid value
Verify the configuration summary reflects the updated automation parameters

title: Empty composer cannot send message
description: Verifies attempting to send with an empty message composer is blocked and no new outgoing message is added to the thread.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open mensajes
Select a conversation from the conversation list
Verify a message validation feedback is visible and no new outgoing message is added to the thread

title: Create campaign draft requires mandatory fields
description: Verifies the campaign creation form blocks saving when required fields are missing and shows validation feedback.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open campaigns
Start creating a new campaign draft
Attempt to save the campaign draft without filling required fields
Verify form validation errors are displayed and the draft is not created

title: Prevent duplicate pending task for same lead and type
description: Verifies creating a second pending task of the same type for the same lead is blocked with validation feedback.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open tareas
Select a lead for the task
Select a valid schedule window or due date
Select the same lead for the task
Select a valid schedule window or due date
Verify a duplicate-task validation feedback is visible and the second task is not created as pending

title: Campaign list handles no matching results
description: Verifies the campaigns page shows an empty state when filters yield no results.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open campaigns
Fill a search keyword unlikely to match any campaign into the search field
Verify an empty state is displayed for no matching campaigns

title: Invalid credentials show a login error
description: Verifies that submitting invalid credentials shows an authentication error and the user is not signed in.

steps.description: Fill invalid-user@example.com into the email field
Fill wrong-password into the password field
Verify an invalid credentials error is visible
Verify the user remains on the login page
